Easy, big guy.|[[Isaak]] on Wave 20 ([[Victory Field]])|audio = AdidasMission3Wave20-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== '''Felipe''', internally referred to as the '''Trophy''', was the final boss of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had high health but very slow speed. It had two abilities. Its first, ''Smash'', in which it slams its fists onto a tower or unit, stunning it and other nearby towers for 3 seconds and doing 1,000 damage to units. Its second, ''Throw'', had it throw a rock at a nearby tower or unit, which then splits into four smaller rocks. Each rock stuns towers for 5 seconds and does 500 damage to units per rock. ==Appearance== '''Felipe''' has green skin, a bulky body and large lower arms. It wears a white Adidas T-shirt with the sleeves being black, black shorts, nylon webbing containing a packet of sports bottle, backwards sports cap, white socks and stylized Adidas shoes. Both sleeves have a white Adidas symbol on the sides while having three horizontal stripes on the top of each sleeve; at the bottom, it contains one white line. On the right of '''Felipe's''' shirt, there is a black Adidas symbol patch. The T-shirt has a black collar and a stylized fade black honeycomb pattern starting from half of the torso down until the waist. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Militant]] and [[Trapper]] can be used to take down '''Felipe'''. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} FelipeCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BackyardLegendsPI.png|'''Felipe''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} BackyardLegendsIcon.png|'''Felipe''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} AdidasMission3EasyRender.png|'''Felipe''' on the matchmaking icon. AdidasMission3HardRender.png|'''Felipe''' on the matchmaking icon. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FelipeIconIG.png|'''Felipe''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *'''Felipe''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *'''Felipe''' re-uses some assets from the [[Brute]], such as body part meshes, abilities and [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] statistics. *The face is based on the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/207033123750918/Radioactive-Beast-Mode Radioactive Beast Mode] face from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Felipe''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Felipe's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Felipe''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{VictoryField|[[Goal Keeper]]|Wave 17|Felipe|Wave 20|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
